sentences.text: It is further submitted that the opposite party no. 2 had given some amount to the petitioner for depositing towards income tax but it is alleged that the amount was not deposited by the petitioner and the same was siphoned off.
It is next submitted that petitioner has deposited the entire amount and even has paid fine of Rs.13 lakhs on account of delayed filing of the return of the income tax.

It is further submitted that opposite party no. 2 has also issued letter dated 23.05.2022 (Annexure-5 to this application) certifying about the filing of income tax return by the petitioner with late fine and further the letter also records that no dues as on date stand against the petitioner.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Kundan/-
